{-# LANGUAGE BangPatterns #-}
import Control.Exception (evaluate)
import Control.Monad (forM_, replicateM_)
import Data.IORef
import GHC.Stats
import Infera hiding (main, solveQuery)
import qualified Infera.Core.Run as Run
import System.CPUTime (getCPUTime)
import System.Mem (performGC)

main = do
  loaded <- loadFile "bench/bench.nprolog"
  (program,_) <- either fail pure loaded
  forM_ [("nrev","once (bench_nrev 100, range 1 30 L, nrev L Result)?"),
         ("loop","once (loop 90000, Result = 90000)?"),
         ("fib","once (fib 25 Result)?"),
         ("queens","once (queens 8 Result)?")] $ \(name,text) -> do
    query <- either fail pure (parseQuery text)
    sink <- newIORef (pure Run.Stop)
    let prepare nonce = do
          let shifted = query {queryNVars=queryNVars query+2+nonce `mod` 4}
          (reason,first) <- Run.runCoreWith 262144 program shifted
          maybe (pure ()) fail reason
          writeIORef sink first
    forM_ [1..10] prepare
    forM_ [1..3::Int] $ \round_ -> do
      performGC
      before <- getRTSStats
      cpu0 <- getCPUTime
      forM_ [1..512] prepare
      cpu1 <- getCPUTime
      performGC
      after <- getRTSStats
      let ms=fromIntegral (cpu1-cpu0)/1e9/512::Double
          bytes=fromIntegral (allocated_bytes after-allocated_bytes before)/512::Double
      print (name,round_,ms,bytes)
    first <- readIORef sink
    let drain !answers action = action >>= \step -> case step of
          Run.Stop -> if answers==1 then pure () else fail "bad answer count"
          Run.Yield (Found state) next -> do
            _ <- evaluate (length (showAnswer (projectAnswer query state)))
            drain (answers+1) next
          Run.Yield _ _ -> fail "Unexpected search item"
          Run.Abandon why -> fail why
    drain (0::Int) first
